title: The Slap
issue: The danger is stated but not acted on, leaving the threat feeling abstract.
fix: Adrian steps forward, slides the pendant onto Lena's neck, whispering, 'Your time starts now.'
last_line: ADRIAN: (cold) Because the last woman who wore it died twenty years ago. In my house.

title: The Offer
issue: The ominous text is not followed by an immediate reaction, reducing urgency.
fix: Adrian's eyes narrow as he reads, then he leans close, murmuring, 'Then we have a problem.'
last_line: Adrian freezes and slowly looks at Lena.

title: Settling In
issue: The episode ends with a calm resolution, offering no hook for the next part.
fix: As Lena turns off the lamp, a distant scream echoes from the upstairs hallway.
last_line: She smiles, turns off the lamp and goes to sleep.

title: The Ex Returns
issue: The threatening note is isolated; the antagonist’s presence isn’t felt at the moment.
fix: When Lena reads the note, Adrian steps into the doorway, his expression unreadable.
last_line: On the back: "Leave him. Or she stops breathing."

title: The Gala
issue: Lena’s mugshot appears but no immediate consequence is shown.
fix: A security guard approaches Lena, whispering, 'We need to talk, Ms. Blackwood, now.'
last_line: Gasps. Adrian lets go of Lena's hand.

title: Morning After
issue: The scene ends with quiet breakfast, offering no forward momentum.
fix: Adrian slides a sealed envelope across the table, saying, 'Read this when you're alone.'
last_line: They eat breakfast in silence. Lena sighs of relief.

title: The Hug
issue: The syringe threat is implied but not directly confronted.
fix: Mrs. Hale turns, syringe glinting, and whispers, 'You can't escape,' as Lena watches terrified.
last_line: They hug. Over Adrian's shoulder, Lena sees Mrs. Hale walking away with an empty syringe.

title: Confrontation
issue: Adrian’s promised explanation is vague, leaving the audience unsure what’s at stake.
fix: Adrian meets Lena's gaze, saying, 'I chose you because you're the heir to Blackwood.'

title: The Explanation
issue: The episode resolves with a calm goodbye, providing no hook for continuation.
fix: The door bursts open; Victoria stands in the frame, gun raised, eyes on Lena.
last_line: LENA: Okay. I believe you. Goodnight, Adrian.

title: The DNA Test
issue: Victoria’s line 'It's time' is mysterious without a clear next action.
fix: Victoria leans in, whispers, 'We move tonight,' then hangs up the phone.
last_line: Behind him, Victoria listens at the door and dials a number: "It's time."

title: A Quiet Day
issue: The opening is tranquil and offers no conflict; the ending resolves peacefully, giving viewers no reason to stay.
fix: After Lena smiles, she glances at her phone, reads a cryptic text: “We need to talk—now,” and the screen cuts to black.
last_line: Lena smiles. The camera rises over the beautiful estate.

title: The Will
issue: The cliff ends with a question but lacks immediate tension; the audience isn’t forced to watch the next episode.
fix: As Lena whispers, “Then who am I?” a shadowed figure steps into the doorway, eyes fixed on the DNA report.
